title: [Global Home - Partner Network Responsive] Editorial Banner Photo (.gns-home-partners-photo) Locked at 563×237px on 758px–1439px Viewports, Leaving Up to 669px Blank Gap
steps_to_reproduce: Open https://web.stag.goodnstay.com/en-US/home on any Laptop or Tablet viewport between 758px and 1439px wide (e.g., 1280×800, 1024×768, or 768×1024).
Scroll down to the 'GROW WITH goodNstay · PARTNER NETWORK' section (.gns-home-partners).
Inspect the top editorial banner (.gns-home-partners-editorial) and measure getBoundingClientRect() of the container vs .
actual_result: - At @media (max-width: 1439px), .gns-home-partners-editorial switches from a 505×191px right-column card to a full-width 160px-tall banner (1232×160px at 1280×800, 961×160px at 1024×768, 705×160px at 768×1024), and the overlay .gns-home-partners-photo-veil stretches across 100% width. - However, retains its desktop hardcoded dimensions width: 563px; height: 237px (only overridden at <= 757px mobile), abruptly cutting off at x = 587px (24px + 563px) and leaving a solid empty dark-blue gap across the right half of the banner: 669px blank (54% of banner width) at 1280×800, 398px blank at 1024×768, and 142px blank at 768×1024, while cropping 77px vertically.
expected_result: - Across all 758px–1439px viewports where .gns-home-partners-editorial spans full container width, .gns-home-partners-photo must use width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover (with appropriate object-position) so the editorial banner image fills the entire banner width without an abrupt cutoff or empty gap.

evidence.console: 0 uncaught JS errors; at 1280×800 .gns-home-partners-editorial rect={x:24, w:1232, h:160, right:1256} vs .gns-home-partners-photo rect={x:24, w:563, h:237, right:587} -> 669px unfilled width.
evidence.notes: Root Cause (Missing Tablet/Laptop Media Query Rule): @media (max-width: 1439px) resizes .gns-home-partners-editorial to width: 100%; height: 160px, and @media (max-width: 757px) resizes .gns-home-partners-photo for mobile, leaving 758px–1439px inheriting desktop fixed width: 563px; height: 237px.

classification: Confirmed Bug — Laptop & Tablet Responsive Banner Image Cutoff
